scope: Internal BRISC calibration comparison; not clinical validation

weight_source.role: development fitting weight only; no inference-time routing

final_all_validation.status: proposed operational only; not used for reported metrics

gate.rule: Whole-image ECE <=0.04 and low-reliability-quintile whole-image ECE and NLL do not worsen.

limitations: Weights transfer frozen v1 OOF reliability scores to E08 rather than using an E08 reliability model, which is not available before Stage 4.
All metrics use the internal validation partition used during model development.
Patient independence and external generalization are unverified.
